verdict.rationale: ADK ships built-in evaluation: test files per session used as unit tests, groundtruth- and rubric-based tool-use metrics, expected tool trajectories, and an `adk eval` CLI command that runs an evalset against an agent. A scriptable CLI makes CI use plausible, but no evidence documents a CI integration, pass/fail thresholds or exit codes. Missing for 10: documented CI pipeline integration, pass/fail gating and scoring-threshold details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can score agent quality with built-in evals and run them as part of CI

citations.quote: ADK provides both groundtruth based and rubric based tool use evaluation metrics.
It's most effective during active agent development, serving as a form of unit testing.
Expected Intermediate Tool Use Trajectory: The tool calls we expect the agent to make in order to respond correctly to the user query.
